Auth.description: Auth is the authentication envelop for handling both ENV-based token and secret reads for cross: authentication

secretRef.description:
SecretRef locates a Kubernetes Secret whose data key holds a bearer token
Mutually exclusive with Token. inrun validate enforces this

token.description: Token is a bearer token for the endpoint. $ENV_VAR syntax supported.

Condition.description: Condition is one test against the CR or runtime state.

between.description: Between passes when the field's number is inside an inclusive "min,max" range.

contains.description: Contains passes when the field's value contains this text.

cron.description:
Cron — a standard cron expression (5-field) that defines when the
window opens. Duration defines how long the window stays open.
Without Duration, the window stays open until the next fire. Add Duration to close it sooner.

dayOfWeek.description:
DayOfWeek — active on the specified days of the week.
  or:
    - dayOfWeek:
        in: [Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday]

duration.description: Duration — how long a cron-opened window remains active.

equals.description: Equals passes when the field's value is exactly this text.

exists.description:
Exists, when true, passes when the field is present and non-empty. A
condition with no comparison at all means exists.

field.description:
Field — dot-notation path to a field in the CR object or a runtime metric.
e.g. "spec.environment", "metrics.queueDepth", "cross.managed-database.metrics.queueDepth"

greaterThan.description: GreaterThan passes when the field's number is above this one (strict).

in.description: In passes when the field's value is one of a comma-separated list.

lessThan.description: LessThan passes when the field's number is below this one (strict).

max.description: Max is an inclusive upper bound: the field's number is at most this.

min.description: Min is an inclusive lower bound: the field's number is at least this.

negate.description:
Negate — when true, the result of this condition is inverted.
Applies to all condition types: field comparisons, time windows, dayOfWeek, cron.

  when:
    - dayOfWeek:
        weekday: true
      negate: true   # passes on weekends

notBetween.description: NotBetween passes when the field's number is outside an inclusive "min,max" range.

notContains.description: NotContains passes when the field's value does not contain this text.

notEquals.description: NotEquals passes when the field's value is not this text.

notExists.description: NotExists, when true, passes when the field is absent or empty.

notIn.description: NotIn passes when the field's value is none of a comma-separated list.

notPrefix.description: NotPrefix passes when the field's value does not start with this text.

notSuffix.description: NotSuffix passes when the field's value does not end with this text.

prefix.description: Prefix passes when the field's value starts with this text.

regex.description: Regex passes when the field's value matches this RE2 pattern.

source.description:
Source is the HTTP fallback for cross-binary metric observation.
Only used when field is a cross.<crd>.metrics.* field and the CRD
is not registered in GlobalCrossMetricsRegistry (different binary).
The endpoint must be the remote operator's /blueprint/{crd} URL.

  when:
    - field: cross.managed-database.metrics.queueDepth
      greaterThan: "500"
      source:
        host: "http://inrun-database-operator:8080"
		   crd: managed-database
  when:
    - field: cross.managed-database.metrics.queueDepth
      greaterThan: "500"
      source:
        endpoint: "http://non-inrun-database-operator:8080/api/managed-database/metrics"

suffix.description: Suffix passes when the field's value ends with this text.

time.description:
Time — active when the current time is within the declared window.
After and Before are both optional; omit one for a half-open range.
  or:
    - time:
        after: "08:00"
        before: "20:00"

typeOf.description:
TypeOf passes when the field's value has this type: map, slice,
string, number, bool or null (the names the typeOf function returns).

unique.description:
Unique, when true, passes when no other instance of the CRD has the same
value at Field. Always passes where no uniqueness checker is available
(e2e, simulate without a seeded fixture).

CrossSource.description: CrossSource declares how to fetch cross-binary/cluster data for a CRD.

auth.description:
Auth handles both ENV-based token and secret reads for cross: authentication
	auth:
	  secretRef:
		name: cross-secret
		namespace: cross-namespace
		key: password

cacheFor.description:
CacheFor controls how long to cache the result before calling again.
Default: 30s — prevents hammering the endpoint on every evaluation.

endpoint.description:
Endpoint is a fully-qualified URL. If set, Inrun uses it directly
and ignores Host/Protocol/Namespace. Template expressions supported.

host.description:
Host is the base URL of a remote Inrun runtime, e.g.:
  http://inrun-runtime.loader-system:8080
Combined with Type to build the final URL.

namespace.description:
Namespace overrides the CR namespace when building info/events URLs.
Optional — defaults to the CR's own namespace.

protocol.description:
Protocol selects which Inrun-native endpoint to call.
One of: "info", "metrics", "health", "events".
Default: "info".

DayOfWeekCondition.description: DayOfWeekCondition declares which days the condition is active.

in.description: In — active on these days. Full English names: Monday, Tuesday, etc.

notIn.description: NotIn — active on all days except these.

weekday.description: Weekday — active Mon–Fri. Shorthand for in: [Monday..Friday].

weekend.description: Weekend — active Sat–Sun. Shorthand for in: [Saturday, Sunday].

Duration.description: A duration: Go units (15s, 2m, 1h) or d, w, mo, y

KubernetesSecretRef.description: KubernetesSecretRef locates a Kubernetes Secret that holds a bearer token.

key.description: Key is the data key within the Secret whose value is the token.

name.description: Name is the Kubernetes Secret name.

namespace.description:
Namespace is the Secret's namespace. Required on an external: call's
auth (in a Blueprint or an e2e step); for gateway API tokens and the
remote reconciler's auth it defaults to Inrun's own namespace.

rotateAfter.description:
RotateAfter is an optional duration (e.g. "90d", "720h").
When set, the gateway checks the inrun.dev/generated-at annotation on
the Secret; if the age exceeds this duration, it deletes and recreates
the Secret with a new uuidv4 token.

PresetRegistry.description: PresetRegistry holds all user-defined presets declared in a Blueprint or Module.

containerSecurity.description:
ContainerSecurities — named container security settings, for
securityContext.preset.

hpa.description: HPAs — named autoscaling behaviour, for a HorizontalPodAutoscaler's preset.

include.description:
Include — a YAML file, relative to this one, whose presets: block is
added before the presets declared here.

limitRanges.description: LimitRanges — named default limits, for a LimitRange's preset.

networkPolicies.description: NetworkPolicies — named policy rules, for a NetworkPolicy's preset.

pdb.description: PDBs — named disruption budgets, for a PodDisruptionBudget's preset.

podSecurity.description: PodSecurities — named pod security settings, for podSecurity.preset.

probes.description: Probes — named probe timings, for a probe's preset.

reconciler.description: Reconciler presets tune a CRD's own reconciler, so they stay Inrun's.

resourceQuotas.description: ResourceQuotas — named quota limits, for a ResourceQuota's preset.

resources.description: Resources — named requests and limits, for a container's resources.preset.

rollingUpdate.description: RollingUpdates — named rollout strategies, for rollingUpdate.preset.

PresetsInclude.description: PresetsInclude is the file presets.include names: each list added before the inline entries.

behaviour.description:
Behaviour — per-CRD queue behaviour. Configures what happens when the queue
reaches its capacity limit or a declared depth threshold.

Without conditions (always drop on limit):

	queue:
	  behaviour:
	    onLimit:
	      drop: true

With conditions (delegate drop decision to the evaluator):

	queue:
	  behaviour:
	    onLimit:
	      when:
	        - field: "{{ inBusinessHours }}"
	          equals: false

failureThreshold.description:
FailureThreshold — consecutive failures before CRD health degrades.
0 → uses FAILURE_THRESHOLD env var.

maxDepth.description:
MaxDepth — depth reference for behaviour:. 0 means unlimited — no items are dropped based
on depth alone. A positive value sets the limit at which behaviour.onLimit fires and the
100% reference for behaviour.onThreshold. Has no effect without a behaviour declaration.

retryBackoff.description:
RetryBackoff — per-CRD backoff applied inside the reconcile loop when
the reconciler returns an error before re-enqueuing. Shorthand ("5s")
sets initial only; full form controls initial/max/multiplier/maxAttempts.

shared.description:
Shared — use the shared default workqueue instead of a per-CRD queue.
Default: false (each CRD gets its own isolated queue).

type.description:
QType — chooses the type of workqueue to be used.
Valid values are "delayed", "ratelimited"

	queue:
	  type: "delayed"

Default is ratelimited

QueueBehaviour.description: QueueBehaviour is declared under queue.behaviour It contains what happens to the queue on limit (currently supported)

onLimit.description: Declares what happens to an item when the queue capacity has reached its limit

onThreshold.description:
OnThreshold declares what happens when a depth-percent threshold is reached.
value: is required and must be between 1 and 100 — it is the queue fullness
percentage at which the behaviour fires. drop: is always true when onThreshold
is declared; setting it to false is accepted but warned.

	queue:
	  behaviour:
	    onThreshold:
	      value: 70

With conditions (delegate drop decision to the evaluator):

	queue:
	  behaviour:
	    onThreshold:
	      value: 70
	      when:
	        - field: "{{ inBusinessHours }}"
	          equals: false

QueueBehaviourSetting.description: QueueBehaviourSetting defines the action taken when the queue reaches its limit or threshold.

drop.description:
Drop controls whether the item is dropped when the limit/threshold fires.
Default: false (unlimited queue). onThreshold always sets drop to true.

or.description:
Or is a list of conditions where at least ONE must be true for the
field to be visible. OR counterpart to When (AND).

value.description:
Value is the queue-fullness percentage at which onThreshold fires.
Required under onThreshold; ignored under onLimit. Must be 1–100.

when.description:
When is a list of conditions that must ALL be true for this field to be
visible. Evaluated client-side as the user fills the form. An empty When
means the field is always visible.
Supports: equals, notEquals, time, dayOfWeek, cron, negate — same as
template source when: blocks.

ReconcilerPresetDef.description: ReconcilerPresetDef defines a named reconciler tuning preset.

description.description: Description — shown by inrun validate and in the reference.

name.description: Name — what a CRD's reconcile.preset refers to.

queue.description: Queue — work queue settings, as in reconcile.queue.

resync.description: Resync — how often the informer re-lists every CR.

anyOf.description: RetryBackoffConfig is declared under queue.retryBackoff or external[].retryBackoff.

initial.description: Initial is the first backoff delay. Default: 500ms.

max.description: Max caps the delay so it does not grow unboundedly. Default: 30s.

maxAttempts.description: MaxAttempts is the total number of calls including the first. Default: 3.

multiplier.description: Multiplier scales the delay after each attempt. Default: 2.0.

RetryBackoffConfig.description: RetryBackoffConfig is declared under queue.retryBackoff or external[].retryBackoff.

TimeWindow.description: TimeWindow declares a clock-based active window.

after.description: After — active after this time (format: "HH:MM" in 24h).

before.description: Before — active before this time (format: "HH:MM" in 24h).

kubewright.CapabilitiesConfig.description: CapabilitiesConfig is the Linux capabilities to add and drop.

add.description: Add — capabilities to add to the default set.

drop.description: Drop — capabilities to remove; ["ALL"] removes every one.

kubewright.HPABehavior.description: HPABehavior is how fast a HorizontalPodAutoscaler scales up and down: a preset, or ScaleUp and ScaleDown.

preset.description:
Preset — web, api, latency-sensitive, batch, cost-optimized, or one
from the registry. presets.ExpandHPA expands it.

scaleDown.description: ScaleDown — how fast replicas are removed.

scaleUp.description: ScaleUp — how fast replicas are added.

kubewright.HPAScalingPolicy.description: HPAScalingPolicy limits one scaling step per period.

type.description: Type — Pods (a count) or Percent (of current replicas).

value.description: Value — the pods or percent allowed per period.

kubewright.HPAScalingRules.description: HPAScalingRules is one scaling direction, up or down.

policies.description: Policies — the limits on each step; SelectPolicy picks among them.

selectPolicy.description: SelectPolicy — Max, Min or Disabled. Default: Max.

stabilizationWindowSeconds.description:
StabilizationWindowSeconds — how far back to look before acting.
Kubernetes defaults: 300 down, 0 up.

kubewright.LimitRangeItem.description: LimitRangeItem is the defaults and bounds for one type of object in a namespace.

default.description: Default — the limits given to a container that sets none.

defaultRequest.description: DefaultRequest — the requests given to a container that sets none.

max.description: Max — the most each resource may be, e.g. {"cpu": "2", "memory": "4Gi"}.

maxLimitRequestRatio.description: MaxLimitRequestRatio — the most a limit may be, as a multiple of its request.

min.description: Min — the least each resource may be.

ports.description: Ports — the ports allowed. Empty allows every port.

to.description: To — the destinations allowed out. Empty allows every destination.

kubewright.NetworkPolicyIPBlock.description: NetworkPolicyIPBlock describes an IP CIDR range.

except.description: Except — ranges inside CIDR to leave out.

from.description: From — the sources allowed in. Empty allows every source.

ports.description: Ports — the ports allowed. Empty allows every port.

kubewright.NetworkPolicyPeer.description: NetworkPolicyPeer selects a set of pods or namespaces.

ipBlock.description: IPBlock — a range of IP addresses.

namespaceSelector.description: NamespaceSelector — namespaces, by label. Empty selects every namespace.

podSelector.description:
PodSelector — pods in the policy's namespace, by label. Empty selects
every pod.

kubewright.NetworkPolicyPort.description: NetworkPolicyPort describes a port allowed by a rule.

port.description: Port — a port number or name.

presets.ContainerSecurity.description: ContainerSecurity is a named container security context.

allowPrivilegeEscalation.description:
AllowPrivilegeEscalation — false stops a process gaining more privileges
than its parent.

capabilities.description: Capabilities — Linux capabilities to add and drop.

description.description: Description — what the preset is for.

name.description: Name — what a securityContext.preset names to use this preset; names ignore case.

readOnlyRootFilesystem.description: ReadOnlyRootFilesystem — true mounts the container's root filesystem read-only.

runAsGroup.description: RunAsGroup — the group ID the container runs as.

runAsNonRoot.description: RunAsNonRoot — true refuses to start the container as root.

runAsUser.description: RunAsUser — the user ID the container runs as.

presets.HPA.description: HPA is a named HorizontalPodAutoscaler setup: replica bounds, a CPU target and scaling behavior.

behavior.description: Behavior — how fast to scale up and down. Replaces the HPA's behavior.

description.description: Description — what the preset is for.

maxReplicas.description: MaxReplicas — the most pods, used when the HPA sets none.

minReplicas.description: MinReplicas — the fewest pods, used when the HPA sets none.

name.description: Name — what a HorizontalPodAutoscaler's behavior.preset names to use this preset; names ignore case.

targetCPUUtilizationPercentage.description:
TargetCPUUtilizationPercentage — the average CPU use to scale toward,
used when the HPA sets none.

presets.LimitRange.description: LimitRange is a named set of LimitRange items.

description.description: Description — what the preset is for.

limits.description:
Limits — per-container and per-pod defaults and bounds, used when the
LimitRange sets none.

name.description: Name — what a LimitRange names to use this preset; names ignore case.

presets.NetworkPolicy.description: NetworkPolicy is a named set of NetworkPolicy rules.

description.description: Description — what the preset is for.

egress.description: Egress — the rules for traffic out. Replaces the policy's.

ingress.description: Ingress — the rules for traffic in. Replaces the policy's.

name.description: Name — what a NetworkPolicy names to use this preset; names ignore case.

podSelector.description:
PodSelector — the labels of the pods the policy applies to, used when the
policy sets none. An empty map selects every pod.

policyTypes.description: PolicyTypes — Ingress, Egress or both. Replaces the policy's.

presets.PDB.description: PDB is a named PodDisruptionBudget limit: MinAvailable or MaxUnavailable, each a count or a percentage.

description.description: Description — what the preset is for.

maxUnavailable.description: MaxUnavailable — pods that may be down, used when the budget doesn't set it.

minAvailable.description: MinAvailable — pods that must stay up, used when the budget doesn't set it.

name.description: Name — what a PodDisruptionBudget names to use this preset; names ignore case.

presets.PodSecurity.description: PodSecurity is a named pod security context.

description.description: Description — what the preset is for.

fsGroup.description: FSGroup — the group that owns mounted volumes.

name.description: Name — what a podSecurity.preset names to use this preset; names ignore case.

runAsGroup.description: RunAsGroup — the group ID every container runs as.

runAsNonRoot.description: RunAsNonRoot — true refuses to start any container as root.

runAsUser.description: RunAsUser — the user ID every container runs as.

presets.Probe.description: Probe is a named set of probe timings.

description.description: Description — what the preset is for.

failureThreshold.description: FailureThreshold — consecutive failures before the probe counts as failed.

initialDelaySeconds.description: InitialDelaySeconds — wait this long after start before the first probe.

name.description: Name — what a probe's preset names to use this preset; names ignore case.

successThreshold.description: SuccessThreshold — consecutive successes before it counts as passed again.

timeoutSeconds.description: TimeoutSeconds — how long one probe may take.

presets.Resource.description: Resource is a named set of CPU and memory requests and limits.

description.description: Description — what the preset is for.

limits.description: Limits — the most the container may use.

name.description: Name — what a resources.preset names to use this preset; names ignore case.

presets.ResourceQuota.description: ResourceQuota is a named set of a namespace's hard limits.

description.description: Description — what the preset is for.

hard.description:
Hard — the namespace's limits, e.g. {"pods": "10", "requests.cpu": "4"}.
Replaces the quota's.

name.description: Name — what a ResourceQuota names to use this preset; names ignore case.

presets.RollingUpdate.description: RollingUpdate is a named Deployment rolling update strategy.

description.description: Description — what the preset is for.

maxSurge.description: MaxSurge — pods allowed above the desired count during a rollout.

maxUnavailable.description: MaxUnavailable — pods allowed to be unavailable during a rollout.

name.description: Name — what a rollingUpdate.preset names to use this preset; names ignore case.
